test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_text_index_phrase_cursor ( message String, INDEX idx (message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha', support_phrase_search = 1, posting_list_codec = 'pfor') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS allow_experimental_text_index_phrase_search = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_text_index_phrase_cursor SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('t', toString(toUInt8(log2(1 + cityHash64(number, i) % 1048576)))), range(12)), ' ') FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_phrase_cursor WHERE hasPhrase(message, 't3 t19')
